emails.preheader: Specialty-specific billing strategies that actually work

email_content.html_content:
Medical Billing Miami Beach

MBMB

3 Ways Miami Dermatologists Increase Collections by 20%+ 🔍

Dr. {{last_name}}, based on our experience working with specialty practices across Miami, here are the top 3 billing strategies that dermatologists use to significantly boost their bottom line:

1. Proper Mohs Surgery Coding

Mohs micrographic surgery requires precise coding (17311-17315). Incorrect coding leads to denials. We ensure every stage is properly documented and billed.

2. Cosmetic vs. Medical Documentation

Florida has specific rules about cosmetic procedure documentation. Proper separation of cosmetic and medical records prevents audit issues and claim denials.

3. Modifier 25 Mastery

Using modifier 25 correctly when performing E/M services with procedures can add significant revenue per patient encounter when documented properly.

These strategies apply similarly to other specialties. Would you like us to do a specialty-specific billing analysis for your practice?

emails.preheader: Protect your practice from costly violations

email_content.html_content:
Medical Billing Miami Beach

MBMB

HIPAA Compliance Checklist: Are You Making These 5 Mistakes? 🔒

Dr. {{last_name}}, HIPAA violations can cost your practice up to $1.5 million per violation category. Here's what we see most often:

⚠️ Common HIPAA Mistakes:

  1. Unencrypted email — Sending PHI without encryption
  2. Shared login credentials — Staff sharing EHR passwords
  3. Unsecured mobile devices — Laptops/phones without password protection
  4. Missing Business Associate Agreements — Not having BAAs with vendors
  5. No risk assessment — Skipping required periodic risk analyses

At MBMB, we've invested heavily in HIPAA compliance:

  • ✓ Annual HIPAA training for all team members
  • ✓ 256-bit AES encryption for all data
  • ✓ Regular third-party security audits
  • ✓ Complete BAA documentation
  • ✓ SOC 2 Type II compliant infrastructure

Want a free HIPAA compliance review for your practice? We'll identify gaps and provide actionable recommendations.

Case Study: Miami Cardiology Practice Increases Revenue by $180K/Year 💰

Results at a Glance:
• $180,000 annual revenue increase
• 34% reduction in claim denials
• 12% improvement in first-pass resolution rate

The Challenge

Dr. Martinez's 3-physician cardiology practice in Coral Gables was struggling with claim denials, slow payments, and a billing team that couldn't keep up with complex cardiovascular procedure codes.

The Solution

MBMB implemented:

  • Specialty-specific coding training for all procedures

  • Monthly financial reviews with the practice leadership
